description: Per-equipment daily event detail for the Narratives tab context panel: one row per non-deleted jfb_daily_activities event on the given project+date, with equipment name, duration, operational/delay classification, resolved delay label (2-tier: master code else project-custom code), raw pass_type, and resolved area path. Callers group by equipment_id client-side to compute Op/Delay hour totals and render the event list -- production stats (CY/SF) are fetched separately via the existing jfb_production_stats domain read, not part of this view. Area, pass, TSCA and attachment are the activity's EFFECTIVE values (tr/ea laterals): an activity with no area of its own takes all four from the latest TRANSITION marker on the same equipment and report_date at or before its start, and one with its own area keeps it but takes the marker's attachment when it has none -- the non-native app's buildCombosFromEvents rule, mirrored client-side in src/lib/transitionState.js. Change one and you must change the other.
direct_sql: SELECT da.id AS event_id, da.equipment_id, eq.name AS equipment_name, da.start_date_time, da.end_date_time, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (da.end_date_time - da.start_date_time)) / 3600.0 AS duration_hours, (da.delay_code_id IS NULL) AS is_operational, COALESCE(dc_master.code, pdc.code) AS delay_label, ea.pass_type, da.category, NULLIF(concat_ws(' › ', a1.name, a2.name, a3.name), '') AS area_label FROM usdf.jfb_daily_activities da LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT t.area, t.pass_type, t.tsca, t.attachment_id FROM usdf.jfb_daily_activities t WHERE (NOT (COALESCE(da.area->>'area_id', '') <> '' OR COALESCE(da.area->>'sub_area_id', '') <> '' OR COALESCE(da.area->>'sub_sub_area_id', '') <> '') OR da.attachment_id IS NULL) AND upper(btrim(t.category)) = 'TRANSITION' AND t.is_deleted IS NOT TRUE AND t.project_id = da.project_id AND t.equipment_id = da.equipment_id AND t.report_date = da.report_date AND t.start_date_time <= da.start_date_time ORDER BY t.start_date_time DESC, t.id DESC LIMIT 1) tr ON true CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT CASE WHEN (COALESCE(da.area->>'area_id', '') <> '' OR COALESCE(da.area->>'sub_area_id', '') <> '' OR COALESCE(da.area->>'sub_sub_area_id', '') <> '') THEN da.area ELSE tr.area END AS area, CASE WHEN (COALESCE(da.area->>'area_id', '') <> '' OR COALESCE(da.area->>'sub_area_id', '') <> '' OR COALESCE(da.area->>'sub_sub_area_id', '') <> '') THEN da.pass_type ELSE tr.pass_type END AS pass_type, CASE WHEN (COALESCE(da.area->>'area_id', '') <> '' OR COALESCE(da.area->>'sub_area_id', '') <> '' OR COALESCE(da.area->>'sub_sub_area_id', '') <> '') THEN da.tsca ELSE tr.tsca END AS tsca, CASE WHEN (COALESCE(da.area->>'area_id', '') <> '' OR COALESCE(da.area->>'sub_area_id', '') <> '' OR COALESCE(da.area->>'sub_sub_area_id', '') <> '') THEN COALESCE(da.attachment_id, tr.attachment_id) ELSE tr.attachment_id END AS attachment_id) ea JOIN usdf.jfb_equipments eq ON eq.id = da.equipment_id AND eq.is_deleted IS NOT TRUE LEFT JOIN usdf.jfb_project_delay_codes pdc ON pdc.id = da.delay_code_id AND pdc.is_deleted IS NOT TRUE LEFT JOIN usdf.jfb_delay_codes dc_master ON dc_master.id = pdc.delay_code_id AND dc_master.is_deleted IS NOT TRUE LEFT JOIN usdf.jfb_project_areas a1 ON a1.id = (ea.area->>'area_id')::uuid LEFT JOIN usdf.jfb_project_areas a2 ON a2.id = (ea.area->>'sub_area_id')::uuid LEFT JOIN usdf.jfb_project_areas a3 ON a3.id = (ea.area->>'sub_sub_area_id')::uuid WHERE da.is_deleted IS NOT TRUE AND da.project_id = p_project_id AND da.start_date_time::date = p_report_date ORDER BY da.equipment_id, da.start_date_time

parameters.name: p_report_date
parameters.description: Report date (YYYY-MM-DD) to fetch events for.

columns.name: duration_hours
columns.description: Event duration in hours, unrounded. The caller rounds for display but sums the full-precision values, so its Op/Delay totals match the non-native app, which sums daily_events.duration_hours the same way; rounding each event first shifted 0.01 h between the two totals.

columns.name: is_operational
columns.description: True when delay_code_id is null (productive time).

columns.name: delay_label
columns.description: Delay code label -- master jfb_delay_codes.code if linked, else the project-custom jfb_project_delay_codes.code. Null when is_operational is true.

columns.name: pass_type
columns.description: Raw pkl-jfb-pass-type value (e.g. startup, active_dredging) -- caller resolves the label client-side. Null for delay events.

columns.name: category
columns.description: Raw jfb_daily_activities.category (e.g. ACTIVE PLACEMENT, a delay-code label, or STARTUP/SHUTDOWN). The panel greys out STARTUP/SHUTDOWN rows as auto-filled gap events, matching the non-native app's eventSource() rule.

columns.name: area_label
columns.description: Resolved area path (Area › Sub-area › Sub-sub-area), null segments omitted, matching the non-native app's ' › ' separator. Null when no area is set.
